name: Lingzhi Pickers' Song (Thải Chi Ca)
concept: The outer gate's method is a work song. The children sing the old song of the four hermits while they weed and water the herb terraces, and breathe in time with it, so that Wood qi comes in with the weeding and Water qi with the watering. A child of either root can begin. Most of the valley's outer disciples never cultivate past it, and grow very good herbs.
lore: The founders sang it as they came into the valley in 480 (A071): the song of four old men who would not go down from their mountain to serve an emperor, and picked lingzhi instead.

name: Shang Mountain Lingzhi Canon (Thương Sơn Chi Kinh)

effects.name: Cut to the Root (Đoạn Căn Tái Sinh)
effects.rule: Once a fight, at layer 12 of the Shang Mountain Lingzhi Canon, a killing blow cuts you only to the root: you grow back with 15 % of your maximum health.

concept: The valley's canon grows qi the way the valley grows herbs. The cultivator plants a seed of Wood qi in each meridian and waters it with Water qi, and a layer is a harvest. It is slow, deep and very hard to kill. In a fight its arts seed a foe with spores that ripen into Wood stacks, heal the holder from each harvest, and at the twelfth layer let her come back once from a killing blow, like a herb cut to the root that grows again.
lore: Written in no book: the valley sings it. The founders said they had it from the four hermits' song; the pines say they had it from a Tùng Đào steward in 520, when the first spirit-herb fields were planted (A072). Both may be true.

name: Hundred Herbs Tasting (Bách Thảo Thường Quyết)

effects.name: Bitter Medicine (Khổ Dược)
effects.rule: A passive art (authored wish d33). While you carry fewer than 10 Poison stacks, each Poison tick on you deals nothing and heals you for half the damage it would have dealt; at 10 stacks or more, Poison ticks on you deal damage as usual.

concept: The taster's method. An inner disciple tastes every herb of the valley, poisons first, and learns to take each into her meridians and break it there. At the ninth layer she can name any poison by its taste and hold three of them at once. In a fight it makes the holder hard to poison and lets her turn a poison on her back into a cure.
lore: Every valley-mistress has tasted the hundred herbs. Nghiêm Linh Chi tasted them twice, the second time in 1000, the year she opened the fields to the orphans (A078), because she had to know which herbs a child could weed safely.

name: Grain Rain Canon (Cốc Vũ Kinh)
concept: The elders' secret is named for the spring rain that falls on the sown fields. The holder calls a fine rain of Water qi over the ground she stands on, and everything rooted in it heals and grows, whether herb, holder or Wood stack. Its strongest form waters a dying field back to life, and the valley has used it twice on the river floods.
lore: Made by the valley's second mistress after the great flood of 700 (A074), to bring the drowned fields of the river back. Taught to the mistress and the field-warden.
